notes: Page names Modine as parent. Style 2 ships year-only: year (1st-2nd digits) is text-stated, month (3rd character letter) is chart-image-only. Style 2 description/example letter-count discrepancy: description says five letters, page example 97JKGK153 has four; pattern allows 4-5 letters since both forms decode identically under the stated positions. Style 3 counting: digit-sequence counting cannot yield 6th/7th digits (only five digits present in the example); character positions give a valid decode (1987, month 1). No held styles on this page, so no shape-collision hold applies.

styles.notes: Page: year = 1st-4th numerical digits, month = 5th-6th numerical digits, converted to 0-based half-open ranges. Four-digit year used as-is.
Page: year = 1st-2nd numerical digits; month = 3rd character (see chart) is chart-image-only, so this style ships year-only and the month is held for the image pass.
Page: year = 6th-7th numerical digits, month = 8th-9th numerical digits, read as character positions (see file notes on counting). Converted to 0-based half-open ranges.
